messages:
Anya K: ok team, quick pre-handoff check — i'm going offline in 10m. can the incoming oncall confirm PD, AWS role, and Grafana access?
Sam L: i'm taking primary for the next shift. i have PD access but need to confirm escalation policy edits.
Priya N: i'll be secondary. i can take PD ack/escalation and have grafana read/write.
Anya K: Sam, can you confirm you see the following PD services: 
- redwood-prod-api
- redwood-inference-runtime
- redwood-console?
Sam L: i see redwood-prod-api and redwood-console, BUT redwood-inference-runtime is missing from my PD. getting a 403 when trying to view escalation rules.
incident-bot: [AUTO] reminder: please verify PagerDuty service access before accepting primary. https://pagerduty.example/services
Priya N: Sam, try this — open the service page and check your role. you should be an "Admin" or at least "Responder" for runbook links.
Sam L: on it.
Mike R: pinging infra-ops — did we recently change the inference-runtime PD membership?
infra-bot: Change detected: inference-runtime PD membership updated 8h ago by infra-bot. New owners: infra@redwood.com.
Anya K: thanks. Sam, infra may have replaced wildcard with team list. Quick workaround: Priya, can you add Sam to the service if you have perms?
Priya N: i can. adding Sam now.
Sam L: confirmed i can view the service now. escalation policies visible. thanks.
Anya K: next: aws roles. Sam, can you assume the prod-oncall role in account rw-prod? quick command:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/prod-oncall --role-session-name oncall-session
```
Sam L: running it — getting "AccessDenied: User is not authorized to perform: sts:AssumeRole"
Priya N: odd. you should have the cross-account trust. Mike, any recent IAM changes?
Mike R: we rotated the support-role trust for a security patch last week. maybe your user lost the group membership. Sam, what's your IAM username?
Sam L: sam.l@redwood
Mike R: ok i see you removed from support-ops group earlier today (accidental). re-adding now.
infra-bot: IAM update queued: add sam.l@redwood -> support-ops group. expected propagation ~2m.
Sam L: got the group back. assume-role works, session created.
Anya K: good. remember MFA enforced for assume-role. did you have to use MFA?
Sam L: yes asked for MFA code, passed.
Priya N: Grafana — links for runbooks/dashboards: main oncall dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/ops/oncall-overview ; inference runtime dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/inference/runtime-summary
Anya K: Sam, can you open both and confirm panel-level access (ability to view logs links)?
Sam L: inference dashboard loads, but i get a 403 when clicking "View logs" (opens Loki link).
Mike R: that suggests the Loki datasource uses a special read token. infra will regrant grafana-ds-read to support-ops.
infra-bot: Grafana datasource role binding applied to group support-ops. propagation ~1m.
Sam L: logs link works now. i can open streams and filter by instance-id.
Anya K: excellent. last things: runbook pointers and PD shortcuts — make sure your PD notifications have snooze and acknowledge shortcuts configured.
Priya N: runbooks: 
- inference-high-latency: https://runbooks.redwood.com/inference/high-latency
- inference-outage: https://runbooks.redwood.com/inference/outage
- rollback-deploy: https://runbooks.redwood.com/deploy/rollback
Anya K: also note automatic fallback policy: if inference-runtime latency > 3000ms for 5m, traffic reroutes to small-quantized model via router-v2. runbook has the manual override steps.
Sam L: copying runbooks to my PD notes.
Priya N: coverage gaps: apac night window 02:00-06:00 PST — we currently have only secondary oncall assigned. need a volunteer for that window next week.
Anya K: flagged. i'll post a shift-swap thread in rotations channel.
Sam L: quick checklist i'm leaving for you Priya:
- verify PD escalation for inference-runtime (done)
- confirm assume-role works (done)
- grafana logs access (done)
- confirm runbook links in PD (attaching)
Priya N: got it.
Anya K: one more: if you need to escalate to SRE lead, use PD "escalate-to-sre-lead" shortcut — it pages oncall-leads and creates an incident channel automatically.
Sam L: noted.
infra-bot: Reminder: rotate session keys every 12h for oncall sessions.
Anya K: thanks all. handing off now — good luck.
Priya N: taking primary backup confirmed. see you later! :wave:
